gov.rule.zh: 颜色怎样决定（与产品中显示的规则相同）：任何一项最高优先级的检查未达到就显示红色，两项或以上第二优先级的检查未达到就显示黄色；第三优先级的检查从不改变颜色。红色会如实显示：它标出仍待完成的工作。

gov.f1.ruling: K220 (the owner's MCQ, 2026-10-22 18:0x +08, "Approve all"; W98): the Governance page in plain words, the orchestrator's drafts; zh drafted for the owner's Chinese walk (K161)
gov.f1.en: Every Chora service has its own checked release pipeline: it scans the code for security weaknesses, lists every software part inside, signs the result so anyone can check it is the copy that was built, and tests the running service from the outside. The copies on this computer were built here for the showcase, so they are not signed.
gov.f1.zh: Chora 的每个服务都有自己经过检查的发布流水线：它扫描代码中的安全弱点，列出里面的每一个软件组件，为构建结果签名，让任何人都能核对这就是当初构建出来的那一份，并从外部测试运行中的服务。本机上的副本是为这次展示在本机构建的，所以没有签名。

gov.f2.ruling: K220 (the owner's MCQ, 2026-10-22 18:0x +08, "Approve all"; W98): the Governance page in plain words, the orchestrator's drafts; zh drafted for the owner's Chinese walk (K161)
gov.f2.en: In that pipeline, a team of AI agents must pass its own test before release: a score below its pass mark stops the release.
gov.f2.zh: 在这条流水线中，一组 AI 智能体发布前必须通过自己的测试：分数低于合格线就会阻止发布。

gov.f3.ruling: K220 (the owner's MCQ, 2026-10-22 18:0x +08, "Approve all"; W98): the Governance page in plain words, the orchestrator's drafts; zh drafted for the owner's Chinese walk (K161)
gov.f3.en: Every AI agent is registered with how much freedom it has: simple low-stakes tasks it may do alone, work a person watches, or work a person must approve. The level beyond these, an AI acting outside the system’s checks and records (Chora’s autonomy level 3), is not allowed: the database will not accept it.
gov.f3.zh: 每个 AI 智能体登记时都写明它有多大的自主权：低风险的简单任务可以独自完成，有些工作由人在旁监看，有些工作必须由人批准。超出这些的级别，即 AI 在系统的检查和记录之外行事（Chora 的自主级别 3），是不允许的：数据库不会接受它。

gov.f4.ruling: K220 (the owner's MCQ, 2026-10-22 18:0x +08, "Approve all"; W98): the Governance page in plain words, the orchestrator's drafts; zh drafted for the owner's Chinese walk (K161)
gov.f4.en: Every decision an AI makes is written to a tamper-evident log, each entry sealed to the one before it, so an auditor can check that none was altered afterwards.
gov.f4.zh: AI 做出的每一个决定都写入防篡改的日志，每一条记录都与上一条环环相扣，审计员可以核对没有任何一条事后被改动。
